description: Implementation of the WindowManagerConnector class, which manages interactions with a window manager service, including creating displays, registering/unregistering notifications, and retrieving display info.

classes.name: WindowManagerConnector
classes.description: A class that manages connection and communication with the window manager service, including display creation and notification handling.

classes.name: WindowManagerConnector::WindowManagerNotification
classes.description: Nested class handling window manager notifications, such as user inactivity events.

methods.name: WindowManagerConnector::initializePlugin
methods.description: Initializes the plugin by querying the window manager interface and registering notifications.

methods.name: WindowManagerConnector::releasePlugin
methods.description: Releases resources and unregisters notifications from the window manager.

methods.name: WindowManagerConnector::createDisplay
methods.description: Creates a display with specified application instance ID, display name, user ID, and group ID.

methods.name: WindowManagerConnector::isPluginInitialized
methods.description: Returns whether the plugin has been successfully initialized.

methods.name: WindowManagerConnector::getDisplayInfo
methods.description: Retrieves display information such as XDG directory and Wayland display name based on application instance ID.

methods.name: WindowManagerConnector::WindowManagerNotification::OnUserInactivity
methods.description: Handles user inactivity notifications from the window manager.
